nodes.label: End Workout flow (ended_early)
nodes.rationale: Required reason + second confirm; still advances split and counts for streak

nodes.label: Local rest-end notification
nodes.rationale: On-device notification covers locked phone / other app; no SMS or server

nodes.label: Phase 3: Dashboard, calendar, streak, day detail
nodes.norm_label: phase 3: dashboard, calendar, streak, day detail

nodes.label: Redmi Note 13 5G (HyperOS) target device
nodes.rationale: Battery saver No restrictions + Autostart required because HyperOS kills background apps

nodes.label: Rest-day catch-up on open/resume
nodes.rationale: Rest entries consumed one per calendar day and logged to rest_day_log

nodes.label: Split (repeating cycle of Workout/Rest days)
nodes.rationale: App tracks what's next in the cycle, never the weekday; 1-14 entries with at least one Workout

nodes.label: Android config (permissions, dark theme)
nodes.rationale: Dark theme for gym lighting, high contrast, >=48dp tap targets usable with sweaty thumbs

nodes.label: Build phases
nodes.rationale: Each phase ends with something runnable on the phone

nodes.label: SQLite Data Model
nodes.rationale: Epoch-ms timestamps, local yyyy-mm-dd dates, foreign keys on, versioned migrations from v1, one in_progress session at a time

nodes.label: Gym Assistant App
nodes.rationale: Personal Android app that enforces consistent rest between sets; fully offline, no backend/login

nodes.label: Exact alarm with inexact fallback
nodes.rationale: Use exactAllowWhileIdle; if SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM denied fall back to inexact, in-app popup still works on resume

nodes.label: History copies names; plan snapshot at start
nodes.norm_label: history copies names; plan snapshot at start
nodes.rationale: Editing the plan never rewrites past records or affects a running session

nodes.label: Mandatory weight and reps logging
nodes.rationale: Every set requires weight and reps; bodyweight allows weight 0

nodes.label: Set pre-fill from last time
nodes.rationale: Pre-fill weight/reps from last time same exercise+set number was done; fall back to most recent set of any number

nodes.label: Rest duration rules
nodes.rationale: Between sets: current exercise rest_seconds; after last set: next exercise rest_seconds; after final set: no rest, session completes

nodes.label: Rest timer logic (store end time)
nodes.rationale: Store rest_ends_at, never trust a running countdown, because Android/HyperOS pauses or kills background apps; Timer.periodic only redraws

nodes.label: Split cycle logic (pointer_position / pointer_since)
nodes.rationale: Cycle advances only on finished sessions and elapsed rest days, never by weekday; workout entries are never auto-skipped

nodes.label: Streak algorithm
nodes.rationale: Planned rest days neutral; unplanned misses survive up to grace g (default 1); today not penalised until over

nodes.label: Project structure (lib/ layout)
nodes.rationale: Logic in logic/ kept pure and testable with an injected Clock

nodes.label: graph.json rewritten whole on each build
nodes.norm_label: graph.json rewritten whole on each build
nodes.rationale: Large PR diffs to graph.json are expected; do not flag as churn

nodes.label: Run graphify query before grep/read
nodes.rationale: query/path/explain return a scoped subgraph, much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output

nodes.label: Run graphify update after code changes
nodes.norm_label: run graphify update after code changes
nodes.rationale: AST-only update keeps graph current with no API cost
